# Home wire receipts

These newline-delimited files contain byte-exact UTF-8 WebSocket text envelopes
generated by the actual hub `HomeBridge`, its bounded `SessionHub` delivery
worker, and the loopback fake HomeRelay from `hub/tests/test_home.py`. Names,
HomeKit IDs and the test credential are synthetic; no live relay is contacted.

`hub/tests/test_home_wire.py` regenerates every frame in memory and compares the
bytes during an ordinary pytest run. The firmware host tests read the same
files, so either endpoint changing its interpretation breaks the shared check.
The trailing newline separates frames and is not part of the wire envelope.

| File | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `snapshot.jsonl` | Three ordered chunks: 45 accessories, nine rooms, 12 scenes; 4,088 / 4,070 / 2,954 bytes. Includes clipped 32-byte Unicode names, false favourites, missing state, lock, cover, button and sensor fields. |
| `updates.jsonl` | Partial hue update and independent reachability update. |
| `requests.jsonl` | Set, toggle, scene and failing toggle requests, IDs 101–104. |
| `replies.jsonl` | Corresponding accepted state, accepted scene and generic `busy` error. Requested brightness 67 is normalized by the fake relay to 70. The accepted write state also overrides the earlier hue event. |
| `doorbell.jsonl` | The existing high-priority `card.show` attention envelope with a `home-doorbell-` ID, Dismiss action and deterministic expiry. |
| `offline.jsonl` | Complete cached replacement with `available:false`, every accessory unreachable; 3,931 / 4,011 / 3,219 bytes. |
| `empty.jsonl` | One complete empty/offline snapshot with `reset:true,more:false`. |

The controlled light alias is `acc6ec49fcbbf`, the reachability-only sensor is
`a315febc1153f`, and the requested scene is `s297178749bb1`.

To verify from the repository root:

```sh
cd hub
python -m pytest -q tests/test_home_wire.py
```

To update deliberately after reviewing a protocol change:

```sh
cd hub
ORB_UPDATE_HOME_WIRE_FIXTURES=1 python -m pytest -q tests/test_home_wire.py
```
